001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter }.
008 * Drops an event once its unformatted message has been seen more than
009 * <code>repeats</code> times after the first. Messages with arguments are compared
010 * before the arguments are filled in, even when the event has already been frozen.
011 * Only the <code>cacheSize</code> most recently seen messages are remembered, and a
012 * forgotten message counts from the start again. Events more severe than
013 * <code>level</code> are always kept.
014 * <table class="table">
015 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
016 * <tr>
017 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
018 * <th>Type</th>
019 * <th>Required</th>
020 * <th>Default</th>
021 * <th>Description</th>
022 * </tr>
023 * <tr>
024 * <td><code>{@index "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.repeats" }</code></td>
025 * <td><code>Integer</code></td>
026 * <td><code>true</code></td>
027 * <td>{@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilter#DEFAULT_REPEATS }</td>
028 * <td>Times a message is kept after its first.</td>
029 * </tr>
030 * <tr>
031 * <td><code>{@index "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.cacheSize" }</code></td>
032 * <td><code>Integer</code></td>
033 * <td><code>true</code></td>
034 * <td>{@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilter#DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE }</td>
035 * <td>Messages remembered.</td>
036 * </tr>
037 * <tr>
038 * <td><code>{@index "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.level" }</code></td>
039 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
040 * <td><code>true</code></td>
041 * <td>{@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#WARNING warning}, so errors are always kept</td>
042 * <td>The most severe level that is deduplicated.</td>
043 * </tr>
044 * </table>
045 */
046public final class DedupeFilterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<DedupeFilterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter> {
047
048        /**
049         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
050         * this prefix.
051         */
052        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.";
053        
054        /**
055         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_repeats } = java.lang.Integer</code> Times a message is kept after its first.
056         */
057        static final String PROPERTY_repeats = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "repeats";
058        /**
059         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_cacheSize } = java.lang.Integer</code> Messages remembered.
060         */
061        static final String PROPERTY_cacheSize = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "cacheSize";
062        /**
063         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_level } = java.lang.System.Logger.Level</code> The most severe level that is deduplicated.
064         */
065        static final String PROPERTY_level = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "level";
066        
067        private final String propertyPrefix;
068        final String property_repeats;
069        final String property_cacheSize;
070        final String property_level;
071        
072        private final java.lang.String name;
073        private final java.lang.String filter;
074        private java.lang.Integer repeats = io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilter.DEFAULT_REPEATS;
075        private java.lang.Integer cacheSize = io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilter.DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE;
076        private java.lang.System.Logger.Level level = io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilter.DEFAULT_LEVEL;
077        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable LogMetrics metrics;
078        
079        /**
080         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter }.
081         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.</code>. Route name.
082         * @param filter will fill <code>{filter}</code> in <code>logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.</code>. Name the filter is selected with.
083         */
084        public DedupeFilterBuilder(
085                        java.lang.String name
086                        , java.lang.String filter
087                        ) {
088                try {
089                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
090                                        "name", name
091                                        , "filter", filter
092                                );
093                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
094                        this.name = name;
095                        this.filter = filter;
096                        property_repeats = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_repeats, prefixParameters);
097                        property_cacheSize = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_cacheSize, prefixParameters);
098                        property_level = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_level, prefixParameters);
099                }
100                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
101                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
102                }
103        }
104
105
106        /**
107         * Sets metrics.
108         * Where to count dropped events as {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics#EVENTS_DEDUPLICATED_METRIC}.
109         * Default is <code>null</code>.
110         * @param metrics not configurable through properties Where to count dropped events as {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics#EVENTS_DEDUPLICATED_METRIC}.
111         * @return this builder.
112         */
113        public DedupeFilterBuilder metrics(io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable LogMetrics metrics) {
114                this.metrics = metrics;
115                return this;
116        }
117
118        
119        /**
120         * Sets <strong>required</strong> repeats.
121         * Times a message is kept after its first.
122         * Default is {@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilter#DEFAULT_REPEATS }.
123         * @param repeats <code>{@value #PROPERTY_repeats } = java.lang.Integer</code> Times a message is kept after its first.
124         * @return this builder.
125         */
126        public DedupeFilterBuilder repeats(java.lang.Integer repeats) {
127                this.repeats = repeats;
128                return this;
129        }
130        
131        /**
132         * Sets <strong>required</strong> cacheSize.
133         * Messages remembered.
134         * Default is {@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilter#DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE }.
135         * @param cacheSize <code>{@value #PROPERTY_cacheSize } = java.lang.Integer</code> Messages remembered.
136         * @return this builder.
137         */
138        public DedupeFilterBuilder cacheSize(java.lang.Integer cacheSize) {
139                this.cacheSize = cacheSize;
140                return this;
141        }
142        
143        /**
144         * Sets <strong>required</strong> level.
145         * The most severe level that is deduplicated.
146         * Default is {@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#WARNING warning}, so errors are always kept.
147         * @param level <code>{@value #PROPERTY_level } = java.lang.System.Logger.Level</code> The most severe level that is deduplicated.
148         * @return this builder.
149         */
150        public DedupeFilterBuilder level(java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {
151                this.level = level;
152                return this;
153        }
154        
155        /**
156         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter } from this builder.
157         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter }.
158         */
159        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter build() {
160                try {
161                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilter.of(
162                                        this.name
163                                        , this.filter
164                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_repeats, this.repeats)
165                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_cacheSize, this.cacheSize)
166                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_level, this.level)
167                                        , this.metrics
168                                        );
169                }
170                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
171                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
172                }
173        }
174        
175        @Override
176        public DedupeFilterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
177                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
178                var _repeats = properties.forKey(property_repeats).ofInt().or(this.repeats).validate(__v);
179                var _cacheSize = properties.forKey(property_cacheSize).ofInt().or(this.cacheSize).validate(__v);
180                var _level = properties.forKey(property_level).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilter.parseLevel(_v)).or(this.level).validate(__v);
181                __v.validate();
182                this.repeats = _repeats.value();
183                this.cacheSize = _cacheSize.value();
184                this.level = _level.value();
185                return this;
186        }
187        
188        /**
189         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
190         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
191         */
192        @Override
193        public String propertyPrefix() {
194                return this.propertyPrefix;
195        }
196        
197}
